label:
<think>
The client fails due to Jetty 9.4 API changes: SelectChannelConnector was removed, Connector no longer has setPort, and server-level setSendServerVersion/setSendDateHeader were moved to HttpConfiguration. To adapt:
- Replace SelectChannelConnector with ServerConnector.
- Change the field type from Connector to ServerConnector so setPort is available.
- Configure sendServerVersion and sendDateHeader via HttpConfiguration and pass it to HttpConnectionFactory used by ServerConnector.
- Update imports accordingly by removing the old ones and adding HttpConfiguration, HttpConnectionFactory, and ServerConnector.
These minimal edits keep behavior equivalent and ensure compilation against Jetty 9.4.
</think>
